character.purpose: People and other beings with a will of their own: heroes, rulers, villains, the ferryman everyone avoids.

location.purpose: Places the player can reach or hear about: cities, ruins, regions, rooms.

faction.purpose: Groups with shared goals: houses, guilds, armies, cults, companies.

event.purpose: Things that happened, or will. Give an event a date and it will appear on the timeline.

item.purpose: Objects that matter: relics, weapons, keys, letters, the crown nobody can take off.

creature.purpose: Beasts, monsters and species: where they live and what they do to people who wander too far.

concept.purpose: The rules of your world: magic systems, religions, technologies, laws, languages.

status.stubHint: Only a name or a line so far

world.name: World name
world.contentLanguageHint: The language your lore is written in. It can differ from the interface language, and AI features will write in it.
world.summaryPlaceholder: Two or three sentences a new team member should read first.
world.yearLabelHint: How years are counted in this world. Leave empty for plain years.
world.createLede: You can change all of this later.
world.settingsLede: Name, language, cover and calendar of this world.
world.deleteBody: Deletes the world and every page in it from this browser. This can't be undone.
world.deleteConfirmBody: Every page, link and setting of this world will be removed from this browser. There is no undo.

home.wantedLede: Linked from your pages but not written yet.
home.wantedNone: Every link points to a written page.

chapter.customPurpose: A chapter of your own. Use it for anything the built-in chapters don't cover.
chapter.emptyHint: Tip: you can also create pages straight from a red link in any entry.

chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.lede: Chapters sort your pages. Built-in chapters can't be removed, but you can recolour them and add your own.
chapters.addHelp: For example Vehicles, Languages, Quests or Spells.
chapters.name: Chapter name

page.title: Page title
page.aliasesHint: Other names, separated by commas. Links to any of them lead here.
page.emptyBody: This page exists so others can link to it. Add what you know, even one line.
page.folio: Previous and next entries in this chapter
page.renamedLinks_one: Saved. {{count}} link to this page was updated to the new name.
page.renamedLinks_other: Saved. {{count}} links to this page were updated to the new name.
page.deleteConfirmBody: Links to this page will turn red. This can't be undone.

editor.placeholder: Write in Markdown. Type [[ to link another page.
editor.help: Markdown: # heading, **bold**, *italic*, > sidebar, - list. Type [[ to link a page. Ctrl/⌘+S saves.
editor.previewEmpty: The preview appears here as you write.
editor.renameHint: Renaming: links to “{{old}}” across the world will be updated when you save.
editor.leaveBody: Your changes to this page will be lost.

link.missingTitle: “{{title}}” hasn't been written yet. Click to create it.

search.label: Search {{world}}
search.hint: ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open · Esc to close

backlinks.title: Pages that link here
backlinks.empty: No other page links here yet. Mention it as [[…]] in another entry and it will appear.

infobox.title: Stat block
infobox.empty: No facts yet. Fill in the stat block when you edit this page.
infobox.refsPlaceholder: Type a page name, then Enter
infobox.endBeforeStart: The end date is earlier than the start date.

fieldTypeHelp.text: A single line, such as a title or a nickname.
fieldTypeHelp.longtext: A few sentences. Shown full-width in the stat block.
fieldTypeHelp.number: A number, formatted for the reader's language.
fieldTypeHelp.worldDate: A year in this world's calendar, with optional month and day.
fieldTypeHelp.pageRef: Points at one page. It counts as a link: it shows up in backlinks and becomes a red link if the page doesn't exist.
fieldTypeHelp.pageRefs: Points at several pages, e.g. members or allies. Each one counts as a link.
fieldTypeHelp.select: One option from a fixed list you define.

fields.title: {{chapter}}: fields
fields.lede: These fields make up the stat block of every page in this chapter. Built-in fields can be reordered; your own can also be removed.
fields.empty: This chapter has no fields yet. Add one below.
fields.label: Field name
fields.optionsRequired: A choice field needs at least one option.
fields.deleteBody_one: {{count}} page has a value in this field. The value stays stored but is no longer shown.
fields.deleteBody_other: {{count}} pages have a value in this field. The values stay stored but are no longer shown.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.ledeCalendar: Every dated page, in order, counted in years {{label}}.
timeline.emptyBody: The timeline fills itself from dates you give your pages.
timeline.emptyStep1: Create an Event page and set its Date in the stat block.
timeline.emptyStep2: Or add birth, death and founding dates to characters and factions.
timeline.emptyStep3: Name your world's calendar and its eras in world settings.
timeline.eraEmpty: Nothing dated in this era yet.

graph.title: Relationship graph
graph.lede: {{pages}} pages, {{links}} connections. Links in text and stat blocks both count.
graph.canvasLabel: Graph of {{pages}} pages. The list view shows the same connections as text.
graph.hint: Click a page to see its connections · double-click to open · scroll to zoom
graph.emptyTitle: Not enough links to draw yet
graph.emptyBody: The graph draws itself from links between pages. Link at least two pages with [[Page name]], or use a page field such as Affiliation or Home.

calendar.title: Calendar and eras
calendar.help: Used by the timeline and by every date in this world.
calendar.erasHelp: Named periods of history. They become bands on the timeline. Leave the end empty for an era that is still going.
calendar.monthsHelp: Leave empty if your world only counts years. Otherwise list the months in order.
calendar.beforeHelp: Abbreviation for negative years, e.g. “BF” for before the Founding.
